title: गणेश जी का वाहन चूहा क्यों है? 🐭 | देवताओं के रूप का रहस्य भाग 6
caption:
क्रौंच गंधर्व, ऋषि का श्राप और गणेश जी का पाश 🐭
कहते हैं, तभी से मूषक बना गणपति का वाहन 🙏
आपके घर में गणपति के साथ चूहा है? 👇
first_comment: गणपति बप्पा मोरया लिखें 🐘🙏 आपको सबसे प्यारी गणेश कथा कौन सी लगती है? 👇
sources: Ganesha Purana (Krauncha, a gandharva, cursed by a sage to become a mouse; Ganesha subdues him with his noose, accepts his prayer and makes him his mount, reducing his own weight). Other traditions give other origins (the Gajamukhasura story in popular retellings; the Mudgala Purana); the mouse as mount is first attested in the Matsya Purana. The sage's name differs between retellings so it is left out. Told with 'कहते हैं'. Checked against Wikipedia 'Vahana' and religionworld.in, 1 Nov 2026
